_comment_signature: A signature used to decide if the JSON loaded, even when it was correct that it was an GATAS configuration. Format YYMMDD and only changes when HW config changes that is not backward compatible
_comment_modules: All modules that will be loaded when GATAS starts up

aircraft._comment: All aircrafts and their configurations settings, config::aircraftId will be used to setup the hardware and load the configuration for that aircraft

GatasConnect._comment_pinCode: A pincode to be use for connecting to GATAS Connect online services

GatasConnectUDP._comment_ip: IP Address or DNS name of the server running GATAS Server

AircraftTracker._comment_ddbEnabled: Enable the DDB Database to fetch aircraft registrations
AircraftTracker._comment_prefixEnabled: Add a prefix to indicate what the datasource is of this aircraft
AircraftTracker._comment_showSquawk: Show known squawk codes instead of callsigns
AircraftTracker._comment_ppEnabled: Enable or Disable experimental Path PRediction

Bluetooth._comment_client: The standard SSD and password when GATAS is in Access Point mode

WifiService._comment_ap: The standard SSD and password when GATAS is in Access Point mode
WifiService._comment_clients: A list of Access Points GATAS will be trying to to connect to.
